newsitem.title: USA: NIMO 1,137 MW nuke unit hits full power.
newsitem.headline: NIMO 1,137 MW nuke unit hits full power.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp's (NIMO) 1,137 megawatt Nine Mile Point nuclear power unit 2 was operating at full output Thursday after ramping up from a scheduled outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said in its daily plant status report.
The Scriba, N.Y. unit was shut Sept 28 for the scheduled refueling and maintenance, and began power production over the weekend.
The nearby 610 megawatt Nine Mile Point unit 1 was not producing electricity as of early Thursday morning, after tripping off line late Tuesday due to a generator problem.
Nine Mile Point 2 was expected to resume power production by this weekend following repairs, company officials said earlier.
The Nine Mile Point units are operated by NIMO, which holds 100 percent ownership of unit 1 and has a 41 percent stake in unit 2.
